article.title: LWiAI Podcast #258 - Opus 5.5, Sol and Luna, Muse, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, Xi

harvestedTerms.summary: LWiAI Podcast episode 258 covers Anthropic's Opus 5.5 release, OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol and Luna tiers, Meta's Muse AI agent, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash KV-cache compression, Bonsai 227B ternary model compression, US-China AI diplomacy, reward hacking detection research, a 'pain axis' representation study, and multi-agent scaling via test-time communication. Mostly a news roundup podcast with limited terminological novelty.

article.title: Emerging trends in AI agent evaluation

harvestedTerms.summary: A Princeton/Stanford/UK AISI/Brookings synthesis paper on emerging trends in AI agent evaluation, authored by Kapoor, Narayanan, and collaborators. The paper categorises 33 trends across science/methods, research agenda, and evaluation ecosystem, and argues for independent, multi-disciplinary, and sociotechnical evaluation approaches. Key themes: trajectory inspection vs. outcome-only evaluation, translation failure across evaluation layers, open-world evaluations, the rising cost of frontier evaluation, and access to CoT traces.

mustReadFlagged.reason: A rigorous, interdisciplinary synthesis from Princeton, Stanford, UK AISI, and Brookings that maps 33 emerging trends in AI agent evaluation — covering methodology, research agenda, and ecosystem. Essential reading for anyone who cares about how we actually know whether AI agents do what is claimed: it names the gaps in trajectory inspection, the translation problem across evaluation layers, and the political economy of independence. One of the clearest structural accounts of what a credible agent evaluation field would need to look like.

harvestedTerms.summary: Ben Thompson's Stratechery piece on Apple HomeView traces Apple's trust-based proposition from the 1999 AirPort/WiFi launch through to a new smarthome display product. The article touches on aggregator theory, AI-driven software decompilation enabling personal software, and the smarthome as a new AI interface surface — useful for context and ecosystem framing but primarily a product analysis piece.

article.title: TorchNeuron: running HF models on AWS Trainium is easier than ever

harvestedTerms.summary: Hugging Face announces TorchNeuron, a new PyTorch backend for AWS Trainium that integrates Trainium as a native device, enabling Transformers, Diffusers, and related libraries to run on it directly without the prior XLA-based abstraction layer (Optimum Neuron). The article is technical documentation of a tooling integration, showing code examples for inference and supervised fine-tuning on Trainium hardware.

A minor patch release note for llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1, fixing an httpx dependency breakage caused by a transitive dependency change in LLM 0.33. Thin on conceptual content — primarily a bug-fix announcement for a plugin that exposes Datasette instances to LLM as a tool.
